# Remastered Modding Field Manual

> Techniques and facts about modding the Command & Conquer Remastered Collection (Steam app 1213210), verified in a
> working mod. Each page is self-contained and laid out the same way: when you need it, the fact or method, how it
> was verified, the game build it holds for, and what is still unproven. Licensed CC BY 4.0. EA has not endorsed and
> does not support this product.

Every page's frontmatter carries `holds_for` (the Steam build it was verified on), `status`, and `unproven` (the
claims not yet tested). Pages that patch the launcher's memory also carry `clientg_sha256`. Before applying any
offset from such a page, check the SHA-256 of the user's `ClientG.exe` against it, and stop if they differ.

## Getting started

- [HD-only mods](getting-started/hd-only-mods.md): the manual assumes HD graphics mode; switch off the classic
  option with CNCDisableLegacyGraphicsOption in GameConstants_Mod.xml when new art exists only in HD.

## Launcher data

- [Overriding the launcher's data](launcher-data/overriding-launcher-data.md): a loose file under Data/ replaces
  its CONFIG.MEG member whole; a replacement CONFIG.MEG must keep every member's exact size; GameConstants_Mod.xml
  merges over GameConstants.xml (overwrite="true" replaces a list). The instance server reads none of them.

## Using what the player already owns

- [TD art from the base game](using-what-the-player-owns/td-art-from-the-base-game.md): draw Tiberian Dawn's HD
  art in a Red Alert mod from the base game's TEXTURES_TD_SRGB.MEG, using opener tiles, instead of shipping copies.
- [TD theatres in Red Alert](using-what-the-player-owns/td-theatres-in-red-alert.md): add TD's desert, temperate
  and winter as Red Alert theatres: launcher slots in GameConstants_Mod.xml, a matching TheaterType and templates
  in the DLL.
- [TD sounds from the base game](using-what-the-player-owns/td-sounds-from-the-base-game.md): play Tiberian
  Dawn's sound effects and EVA lines in a Red Alert mod from the base game's sound MEGs, by naming each sound in the
  DLL and adding RAC_/RAR_ alias events; your own samples must be MS-ADPCM.
- [Content built from the player's own games](using-what-the-player-owns/content-from-the-players-own-games.md):
  EA's guidelines bar music files from any C&C game, so convert Tiberian Sun's soundtrack from the player's own copy
  (MIX/AUD to the Remastered MS-ADPCM WAVs) instead of shipping it. Conversion proven; in-game importer is design
  only.

## Maps and the lobby

- [New maps in the skirmish Official list](maps-and-lobby/new-maps-in-the-skirmish-list.md): list maps with
  INSTANCES.XML and CNCMAPPREVIEWDATA.XML (RA's 128-wide grid); start them under Hastings' D6 entry, whose
  OverrideMapName the DLL honours, by hooking ClientG's launch sends and key lookup. Fragile: one ClientG build.

## Art

- [Building selection boxes](art/building-selection-boxes.md): the launcher centres a building's selection box on
  its plot and takes only the size from the DLL; a misplaced box means the art is seated off the plot's centre.

## Patching the launcher in memory (advanced)

- [Re-pointing launcher UI art in memory](clientg-ram/repointing-atlas-regions.md): give a third faction or
  sub-faction its own radar crest and HUD logos by rewriting ClientG's cached atlas-region records. Fragile:
  verified against one ClientG build only.
- [Patching the launcher's code from your DLL](clientg-ram/patching-the-launchers-code.md): ClientG loads the
  mod's DLL at start-up for CNC_Version; DllMain there can pin the DLL and hook launcher functions on every machine.
  Compare stock bytes before every write. Fragile: one ClientG build only.
